limit.description: The size of a page; 25 when left out. A page never splits Announcements released at the same moment.

before.description: The next value of the last page: shows the Announcements released before that time.

versionLookedAt.description: The version of the Story the Announcement looked at.

reviewFlag.description: The one open review flag for a blocked draft, once for each Announcement: id, words, mark, reason and ask.

words.description: The state in words, such as Sent or Blocked: check failed.

mark.description: The Lucide icon of the state.

approval.description: The review in words and a mark: words, mark and approval (none, soft or hard). Null for a Delivery that will not go.

dueAt.description: The earliest time it is still waiting for.

lastAttempt.description: The last attempt: number, at, outcome, code, words and mark.

since.description: When it began, as a UTC time.

attention.description: What needs a person's eye: Overdue (due, with no attempt), Outcome unknown (an attempt with no answer yet, until Caducus settles it), or a failed check.

deliveries.description: One line for each live Delivery, in channel order.

stories.description: In the list: the Stories it is about, each with lineageId and title.

words.description: The state in words, such as Sent or Blocked: check failed.

mark.description: The Lucide icon of the state.

approval.description: The review in words and a mark: words, mark and approval (none, soft or hard). Null for a Delivery that will not go.

dueAt.description: The earliest time it is still waiting for.

lastAttempt.description: The last attempt: number, at, outcome, code, words and mark.

since.description: When it began, as a UTC time.

attention.description: What needs a person's eye: Overdue (due, with no attempt), Outcome unknown (an attempt with no answer yet, until Caducus settles it), or a failed check.

overdue.description: Every Delivery that is due and has no attempt, read from the sparse due index.

next.description: Pass as before for the next page; null on the last page.

tools.name: announcements_explain
tools.description: Why a Story was or was not announced, for each channel, naming the rule. Reads the rules; writes nothing.

story.description: The lineage id of the Story.

rule.description: The rule: announced, off, not_published, type_not_announced, section_not_announced, below_bar, below_floor, machine_five, story_not_reviewed, no_delivery or would_announce.

tools.name: ratings_set
tools.description: Give a Story a star rating, 1 to 5. An agent may give only three or four stars, and only to a Story nobody has rated.

story.description: The lineage id of the Story.

stars.description: The rating, 1 to 5. An agent may only give 3 or 4.

previous.description: The rating before this one: 0 when the Story had none.

tools.name: handoffs_request
tools.description: Ask another responsibility for one piece of work on a Story. It appears on the Story as an Assignment that says who asked and why, and wakes the responsible agent once.

story.description: The lineage id of the Story.

responsibility.description: The responsibility asked, as the agent catalogue names it, such as research.

why.description: What is needed and why, in plain words. It is the Assignment's brief and what the responsible agent reads.

created.description: False when the same ask was already made: nothing new was written and nobody is woken again.
